# sc-accordion

Sections that open and close, for frequently asked questions and long guidance, built on native `<details>` and `<summary>`. Specification: `specs/sc-accordion.md`.

## Usage

```html
<sc-accordion show-all>
  <details>
    <summary>How long does renewal take?<small>Online, in most cases</small></summary>
    <p>Usually about 10 minutes, once your vehicle has passed its technical test.</p>
  </details>
</sc-accordion>
```
